title: Rescaled complement of a set at a Lebesgue density point has vanishing measure
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) with Lebesgue measure Lⁿ, C ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel, w ∈ ℝⁿ and R > 0, and suppose Lⁿ(C ∩ B_r(w))/Lⁿ(B_r(w)) → 1 in [0, ∞] as r ↓ 0 (closed balls). Then Lⁿ({u ∈ B_R(0) : w + tu ∉ C}) → 0 in [0, ∞] as t ↓ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (R : ℝ), MeasurableSet C → 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ volume (C ∩ closedBall w r) / volume (closedBall w r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ volume {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | u ∈ closedBall 0 R ∧ w + t • u ∉ C}) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
